done_2026-07-09_impl5: DONE corner recalibration study (5 approaches): GP systematically UNDER-predicts mu at real process corners (extrapolation bias, up to -20mV at Vop=0.9), first real-data confirmation of the review's corner-anchor hypothesis. Vmin impact smaller (FSG +23mV) since Z-crossing Vop is less sensitive. Compared noise-weight/dup-50x/noise-contrast/one-hot-feature/per-corner-residual. WINNER: per-corner residual correction (sep) -- FSG error 0.0mV AND keeps global contour smooth (dup-50x also hits 0mV but WARPS the contour, unsafe for inverse estimation). Corner coords are the PDK's REAL 3-sigma shifts (FFG(-36,-44) FSG(-29,+39) SFG(+32,-37) SSG(+36,+45)mV), NOT the analytic +-60 assumption -- so the earlier 'corners not sampled' note was wrong, corrected in stage4_real_data_gate.md sec 5. See docs/decisions/corner_recalibration_20260709.md.

DONE reviewed the two revised plans (deck_scenarios.md, revised_sim_plan_20260709.md). Verdict: sound and well-developed. Verified with real data: (a) Vop 0.9 removal justified -- 0/201 conditions cross Vmin in [0.8,0.9] at Z=4/5/6, and [0.7,0.8] has <=1, so Vop 0.4-0.7 (4 levels) may suffice at Z<=5. (b) global-sigma = cn/pu amplitude scaling is physically sound (Pelgrom-linear). (c) smooth_max alpha=0.01V gives 6.93mV crossing bias (numerically verified) -- too large, recommend alpha<=0.002V; fixed in deck_scenarios.md. Risks flagged: MC-mismatch on overlap reuse needs n_mc + noise-aware GP; Z_target still undecided (upstream of everything); weighted-Sobol biases Saltelli sensitivity (use GP-based sensitivity instead). See docs/decisions/revised_plan_review_20260709.md.
